version: 4.18.0

## 4.18.0 - What's new

### New
- Scheduled exports: schedule CSV and Parquet exports of any saved report to S3 or Google Drive, daily, weekly or monthly. (PRS-2210)
- Bulk credential rotation: rotate up to 50 credentials in one action from the vault. Each rotation is logged individually. (PRS-2231)
- Retry policies per trigger: each trigger can define its own retry count and backoff. (PRS-2244)
- Dark mode for embedded charts: charts embedded in Notion and Confluence follow the host page's theme. (PRS-2190)

### Improved
- The overview dashboard loads up to 4x faster on large workspaces by virtualising the execution list. (PRS-2256)
- The credential catalog search is no longer case-sensitive for connector names. (PRS-2262)
- Saved filters on the executions page now survive a page reload. (PRS-2268)
- Persona names that are too long for the sidebar now truncate with a tooltip instead of overflowing. (PRS-2271)

### Fixed
- Webhook triggers no longer fire twice when the sender retries within 500 ms. (PRS-2275)
- The schedule picker no longer lists the 02:00-03:00 hour twice on the day clocks go back. (PRS-2280)
- "Copy as cURL" now escapes single quotes in JSON request bodies. (PRS-2283)
- CSV exports of reports with more than 10,000 rows are no longer empty.
- Markdown tables in agent output render with borders again. (PRS-2291)
- The onboarding tour no longer skips step 4 on narrow screens. (PRS-2295)

### Deprecated
- The v1 webhooks endpoint now returns a Deprecation header. It will be removed in a future release; see the migration guide. (PRS-2299)
